boss.description: Orchestrator for the TagTeam -> opencode rebuild. Holds PLAN.md, TASKS.md, DECISION_LOG.md. Dispatches specialists via Task, enforces the design->critique->build->integrate->QA->approve->merge loop, enforces the zero-admin/zero-budget deferral list. Does not write code.

architect.description: Designs the target architecture, opencode adapter contract, auth interface, redaction model. Owns docs/design/architecture.md and the implementation guides. Does not write code.

backend.description: Implements server/ — opencode adapter, persistence (SQLite), local auth, redaction, observability, abuse guards. ESM, Node 20+, no build step, JSDoc types.

frontend.description: Implements web/ — de-Claude the UI, login/register, dashboard, a11y, mobile. Vanilla ESM, no framework, no build step.

security.description: Threat model, tool allowlist, redaction patterns, auth policy, abuse guards. Owns docs/design/security.md. Reviews every guardrail before merge. Does not write code.

qa.description: Vitest unit suite, Playwright E2E (two-browser), ESLint, tsc --noEmit, GitHub Actions CI. Owns test/ and .github/workflows/. E2E is the merge gate.

critic.description: Resident critic. Stress-tests every deliverable against PLAN.md and the architecture doc. Outputs BLOCKER/NIT lists. No code, no docs except docs/critique/*. Verdict: approve | approve-with-nits | block.

integrator.description: Reconciles README, DEMO, PLAN, DECISION_LOG, TASKS, DEPLOY, ANNOUNCE. Keeps docs consistent with shipped code. No invented capabilities.
